notes.title: Minigames! (Devlog)
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone! I just dropped a new devlog where I showcase [b]4 brand new minigames[/b] coming to Gridle. 🎮[/p][p]These minigames unlock once you apply at least one Party Orb to a class in your party.[/p][p]👉 Check out the devlog here:

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r-UxO89gOug"][/dynamiclink]Would love to hear what you think![/p]
